events.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
events.note: Headline and core consumer inflation from the BLS. The core month-over-month print drives the immediate rates and equity reaction.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

typical_move.summary: Historically moves about as much as a normal day. Implied volatility usually drops into it (-1.9% vs -0.7% on an ordinary day), so the market prices real uncertainty here.

events.title: FOMC Statement & Rate Decision
events.note: Interest rate decision and policy statement released at 2:00pm ET. Expect a sharp repricing in index futures on the release and again during the 2:30pm press conference.

typical_move.summary: Historically moves about 1.6x as much as a normal day. Implied volatility usually drops into it (-3.1% vs -0.7% on an ordinary day), so the market prices real uncertainty here.

events.title: Market Closed — Thanksgiving Day
events.note: US equity markets are closed for Thanksgiving Day. CME equity index futures are also closed or on a holiday schedule -- check CME's calendar for the exact session.

events.title: Quad Witching
events.note: Index futures, index options, single-stock options and single-stock futures all expire. Expect elevated volume all session and a large closing auction.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 13-Week Bill
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 13-Week Bill closes at 11:30 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.
